description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city,
                LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN
                is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create
                (one more than the number of owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who live in the same
                household (same lastName and address, compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace). Assigned on create when the request
                sets sharesHousehold true: all owners sharing the household
                receive the same value. Null for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'e6b1c2d4-0f3a-4b8c-9d2e-1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'GOLD' when the owner's household
                (owners sharing the same householdId) has 3 or more members.
                Otherwise 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email is
                present, else 'BRONZE'. Derived on read.
              type: string
              enum:
                - BRONZE
                - SILVER
                - GOLD
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived on read from the city using a
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false. Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped
            from the national digits; the result must have 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. The E.164 string (e.g. '+61412345678') is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The effective date must fall on a business day: if it lands on
            a Saturday or Sunday it is rolled forward to the following Monday, and
            that adjusted date is what is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only opt-in flag for create. When true it allows creating an
            owner that shares a household (same lastName and address, compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) with an existing owner;
            otherwise such a create is rejected 409. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city,
                LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN
                is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create
                (one more than the number of owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who live in the same
                household (same lastName and address, compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace). Assigned on create when the request
                sets sharesHousehold true: all owners sharing the household
                receive the same value. Null for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'e6b1c2d4-0f3a-4b8c-9d2e-1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'GOLD' when the owner's household
                (owners sharing the same householdId) has 3 or more members.
                Otherwise 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email is
                present, else 'BRONZE'. Derived on read.
              type: string
              enum:
                - BRONZE
                - SILVER
                - GOLD
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived on read from the city using a
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false. Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

Replaced the string membership tier with a numeric `membershipLevel` (1–3), computed and stored at creation.

**Computation** (`AssignMembershipLevel.java`, new): start at 1, `+1` when an email is present, `+1` when `namesakeCount` is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 reserved for tenure). Wired into the create pipeline in `owners.POST.yml` right after `assignNamesakeCount` (which it depends on), under the same `transaction` governance.

**Storage**: added a persisted `membershipLevel` field/getters to `Owner.java` and a `membership_level` column to all four schemas (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres).

**Response**: `openapi.yml` now exposes `membershipLevel` (integer, 1–3, readOnly) instead of `membershipTier`; the generated `OwnerDto` picks it up. `OwnerMapper` drops the `membershipTier` mapping, the `toMembershipTier` method, and the `GOLD_HOUSEHOLD_SIZE` constant — `membershipLevel` now auto-maps by name as a pure projection of the stored value.

**Audit**: `AuditOwnerCreated` records `membershipLevel=` on the create audit line (confirmed in the run: `Owner created: id=11 … membershipLevel=3`).

The new acceptance test (`coreNumericLevel`) passes: a uniquely-named owner with an email gets level `1 + email + namesake0 = 3`.

One thing I left in place deliberately: the `householdSize` derivation (`OwnerHouseholdSize` and the `populate`/`populateAll` calls in the response functions) is now unused by membership logic, but I kept it rather than rip out that infrastructure — it only sets a transient field and removing it would be a broader refactor beyond this change's scope. Let me know if you'd like it cleaned up.
